name: Nara Meideros
summary: In Stormwind's Park, Nara Meideros guides young seekers in Elune's teachings. As a night elf priestess in the human capital, she gives her kin a familiar presence of faith.

sections.title: A Priestess in Stormwind
sections.body: Across the Great Sea from Kalimdor, Nara Meideros serves Elune in Stormwind City. Night elf druids and priests tend a green refuge in the Park, where she guides young seekers in devotion to the Moon Goddess. Nearby, human priests serve the Holy Light in Cathedral Square. Nara keeps night elves visiting or living in the Eastern Kingdoms close to their own faith.

faq.q: Where can I find Nara Meideros?
faq.answer: Find Nara Meideros in Stormwind City's Park district, among moonwells and towering trees that recall home to night elf travelers.

faq.q: What role does Nara Meideros serve?
faq.answer: Nara trains priests, guiding novices and those still growing in the faith. She directs human priests to the Cathedral of Light to learn devotional spells such as Desperate Prayer.

faq.q: Why is a night elf priestess residing in Stormwind?
faq.answer: Night elf ties with the Grand Alliance are growing stronger. Emissaries, druids, and priests from Darnassus keep an active presence in the Park to aid their kin and represent their spiritual traditions.

angles.text: As a night elf priest traveling in the Eastern Kingdoms, you can seek Nara's guidance in important racial devotions without returning to Kalimdor.
Far from Ashenvale and Teldrassil, you can find a comforting piece of home with Nara Meideros in the Park, amid Stormwind's stone walls.
